row1.line1: We are an education-focused technology team dedicated to building tools that schools can depend on daily.
row1.line2: Our platform brings together essential academic workflows: student records, schedules, assessments, communications, and reporting.
row1.line3: We believe in privacy-by-design, responsible data use, and respectful communication with all members of the school community.
row1.line4: We work closely with educational stakeholders to understand real-world challenges and deliver practical, user-friendly solutions.
row1.line5: Our culture values reliability, empathy, and impact—every feature we build serves a clear educational need.

row2.line1: Our mission is to simplify and elevate school operations by connecting administrators, teachers, students, and parents through a unified, reliable, and intuitive platform.
row2.line2: We aim to improve learning outcomes and community engagement by delivering timely, accurate information and streamlined academic processes.
row2.line3: We focus on transparency and trust, ensuring communication about exams, results, and academic requests is clear, accessible, and secure.
row2.line4: We are committed to continuous improvement, listening to our users, and innovating features that make school life simpler and more effective.

row3.line1: Centralized academic management: classes, timetables, exams, results, report cards, and student requests in one place.
row3.line2: Secure messaging and notifications for important events, including exam schedules, results, and administrative updates.
row3.line3: Role-based access for administrators, teachers, students, and parents, ensuring the right information reaches the right people.
row3.line4: Analytics and reporting tools that help track performance and support informed academic decisions.
row3.line5: A user-friendly experience on web and mobile, designed for speed, clarity, and accessibility.
row3.line6: Flexible integrations with messaging channels such as WhatsApp and Telegram for verified, consent-based notifications.
row3.line7: Dedicated support and onboarding to help institutions configure and adopt the platform effectively.

row1.line1: We collect only the data necessary to provide and improve our school management services, personalize the experience, and communicate important academic updates.
row1.line2: Personal data processed may include: name, email, phone number, role (student/parent/staff), class or program details, identifiers for messaging platforms (e.g., WhatsApp number, Telegram user ID), and audit logs.
row1.line3: We use technical cookies and similar technologies strictly for security, session management, and service performance analytics; no unnecessary tracking is conducted.
row1.line4: Payment or financial data, when applicable, is processed securely by vetted payment providers and is not stored on our servers beyond what is necessary for accounting and compliance.
row1.line5: We share data with essential service providers (hosting, messaging, analytics, support) under contracts requiring confidentiality, security, and data processing only on our instructions.
row1.line6: We may disclose data when required by law, court order, or to protect rights, safety, or the integrity of the service.
row1.line7: Users can request access, correction, deletion, portability (where applicable), and can object or restrict certain processing as permitted by law.
row1.line8: We implement administrative, technical, and physical safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of the data; however, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure.
row1.line9: Data is retained only as long as necessary for the stated purposes, legal obligations, dispute resolution, and legitimate business interests, after which it is securely deleted or anonymized.
row1.line10: Links to external sites or services are provided for convenience; their practices are governed by their own policies, which should be reviewed separately.
row1.line11: We may update this policy; material changes will be communicated through the service or other reasonable means, with the effective date indicated.
row1.line12: Children's Privacy: The service is intended for use in an educational context under appropriate oversight; parental/guardian consent is obtained where required by applicable law.
row1.line13: International Transfers: Where data is transferred across borders, we rely on appropriate safeguards (such as contractual clauses) to protect personal data.

row2.line1: Purpose: WhatsApp messaging is used solely to deliver important academic notifications, including exam schedules, exam results, report cards/bulletins, and responses to student service requests.
row2.line2: Legal basis and consent: We use an OTP-based consent flow; messages are sent only after the user (or authorized guardian) provides verifiable consent via OTP.
row2.line3: Data processed: phone number, message content, timestamps, delivery status, and OTP verification meta-data limited to what is necessary for sending and auditing communications.
row2.line4: Retention: We store the OTP proof (code reference or token, consent status, and date/time) in our database as evidence of consent, and retain message logs for compliance and troubleshooting for a limited period.
row2.line5: Restrictions: No marketing or promotional content is sent via WhatsApp; communications are strictly informational and education-related.
row2.line6: Security: Data in transit uses platform encryption; we apply access controls and least-privilege principles to stored consent proofs and logs.
row2.line7: Third parties: WhatsApp and any integrated messaging gateway act as processors/transmission channels; they handle data under their own terms and security standards.
row2.line8: Control: Users can withdraw consent or opt out of WhatsApp notifications at any time using provided settings or by contacting support; we then cease further WhatsApp messaging except for legally required notices.

row3.line1: Purpose: The Telegram Bot API is used solely for important academic notifications such as exam schedules, results, report cards/bulletins, and responses to student requests.
row3.line2: Legal basis and consent: Opt-in is captured through a bot interaction and/or OTP verification; messages are sent only after verifiable consent is recorded.
row3.line3: Data processed: Telegram user ID or chat ID, message content, timestamps, delivery status, and minimal meta-data necessary for bot operations and auditing.
row3.line4: Retention: We store consent evidence (including OTP or bot opt-in record and date/time) and limited message logs for compliance, with defined retention periods.
row3.line5: Restrictions: No marketing or promotional campaigns are conducted through Telegram; communications remain strictly informational and educational.
row3.line6: Security: We protect stored identifiers and logs with access controls and encryption-at-rest where applicable; messages are transmitted via Telegram's infrastructure.
row3.line7: Third parties: Telegram processes data under its own terms and security measures; our bot uses only the permissions necessary to deliver messages.
row3.line8: Control: Users may revoke bot access or opt out from Telegram notifications at any time; upon withdrawal, we stop sending Telegram messages except where legally required.

segmentFaq.title: Find answers to the most common questions about our platform

row1.title: How do I manage staff?
row1.description: As a director, you can add, modify, and remove staff members (teachers, administration, etc.) via the Staff Management section. You will also be able to assign roles and manage access.

row2.title: How do I manage teachers?
row2.description: The Teacher Management section allows you to oversee all aspects related to your teaching staff. This includes assigning courses, managing their schedules, tracking their performance, and handling professional development.

row3.title: How do I manage students?
row3.description: In Student Management, you can enroll new students, update their information, track their attendance, manage their academic records, and monitor their overall progress throughout their time at the institution.

row4.title: How do I manage parents?
row4.description: The Parent Management feature enables you to maintain up-to-date contact information for parents, manage communication preferences, and facilitate access to student progress reports and school announcements.

row5.title: How do I create and manage academic years?
row5.description: The Academic Years section allows you to create new academic years, define their start and end dates, and activate or deactivate them. This includes setting up levels and classes for each year.

row6.title: How do I organize courses and academic levels?
row6.description: In the Course and Level Configuration, you can define the course structure, subjects taught for each level (Nursery, Primary, Secondary, etc.), and assign the corresponding teachers.

row7.title: How do I plan and supervise exams and quizzes?
row7.description: The Exams and Assessments section gives you an overview of all evaluations. Here, you can schedule exam sessions, define grading rubrics, and track quiz progress.

row8.title: How do I manage meetings and communications?
row8.description: Use the Meetings and Communications feature to schedule meetings with staff, parents, or students. You can also send important announcements and notifications.

row9.title: How do I oversee course-specific discussion forums?
row9.description: The Forum Management section allows you to moderate discussions for each course. You can create new conversation topics directly related to course content and ensure exchanges remain constructive for student learning.

row10.title: How do I manage the publication of results?
row10.description: In Results Management, you can validate and publish report cards and exam results. You have full control over the visibility of results for students and parents.

row11.title: How do I handle student requests?
row11.description: The Student Requests feature centralizes all student inquiries (academic, administrative issues, etc.). You can assign these requests to the relevant staff and track their resolution.

row12.title: How do I close the academic year?
row12.description: Academic Year Closure is a crucial step. This feature allows you to finalize results, archive current year data, and prepare for the transition to the new school year.

segmentFaq.title: Find answers to the most common questions about our platform

row1.title: How do I manage my classes?
row1.description: From your Teacher Dashboard, you can effortlessly manage your classes. This includes adding or removing students, viewing class rosters, and setting up class-specific announcements.

row2.title: How do I create and manage courses?
row2.description: Navigate to the Courses section on your dashboard. Here, you can create new courses, upload syllabi, share lecture notes, and organize all your learning materials for each class.

row3.title: How can I create and schedule exams and quizzes?
row3.description: In the Exams & Quizzes section, you can design and schedule various assessments. This includes setting custom formats, defining grading rubrics, and assigning due dates.

row4.title: How do I record and publish student results?
row4.description: Use the Results & Grading feature to efficiently input, calculate, and publish student grades and exam scores. This ensures timely and transparent feedback for your students.

row5.title: How do I handle student and parent requests?
row5.description: The Student Requests section allows you to manage and respond to inquiries from students and parents directly. This includes requests for grade clarifications, assignment extensions, or general information.

row6.title: How do I plan my class schedule and lessons?
row6.description: The Class Planning tool helps you develop and manage your class schedules, create detailed lesson plans, and organize all necessary teaching resources for seamless delivery.

row7.title: How can I get involved in school events?
row7.description: Stay updated with and contribute to school events, parent-teacher meetings, and academic workshops through the Event Coordination section.

row8.title: How do I track student performance and academic levels?
row8.description: Use the Performance Tracking feature to monitor student progress and academic levels. This helps you identify areas for improvement and offer personalized support to your students.

row1.title: How do I enroll in courses?
row1.description: You can easily enroll in your desired courses through the Enrollment section. Follow the simple registration process and you will receive notifications upon acceptance into your chosen programs.

row2.title: How do I access my course materials?
row2.description: Once logged in, navigate to the Courses section on your Student Dashboard. Here, you can view your enrolled courses and access all lecture materials, readings, and multimedia content anytime, anywhere.

row3.title: How can I take exams and quizzes?
row3.description: Scheduled exams and quizzes will appear in the Exams & Quizzes section of your dashboard. You can take them directly within the app and often receive instant feedback on your performance.

row4.title: How do I check my grades and results?
row4.description: Your Grades & Results section provides a detailed breakdown of your latest grades, exam scores, and overall academic standing, allowing you to track your progress effectively.

row5.title: How can I submit a request for assistance or to resolve an issue?
row5.description: If you have a problem or need assistance, use the Problem Requests feature to submit a request directly to your teachers or the school administration.

row6.title: How do I plan my academic schedule?
row6.description: The Academic Planning tool allows you to view your daily and weekly class schedules, manage assignment deadlines, and plan your study time effectively to stay organized.

row7.title: How do I stay informed about school events?
row7.description: Stay updated with important school events, academic calendars, and extracurricular activities through the School Events section on your dashboard.

row8.title: How can I monitor my academic progress?
row8.description: The Progress Monitoring feature helps you track your academic level and progress in each subject, ensuring you meet your educational goals and identify areas for improvement.

row1.title: How do I link my children to my account?
row1.description: After logging in for the first time, you can easily link and manage all your children profiles from a single account by browsing and selecting them from the student directory.

row2.title: How can I monitor my children grades and results?
row2.description: Your Parent Dashboard provides access to Grades & Results where you can monitor your children academic performance, including individual subject grades and exam scores.

row3.title: How do I track my children attendance?
row3.description: In the Attendance Tracking section, you can keep tabs on your children attendance records and receive real-time alerts for any absences or tardiness.

row4.title: How can I communicate with teachers or the school?
row4.description: The Communication & Requests feature allows you to send messages directly to your children teachers and school administration, and submit any requests regarding their education.

row5.title: How do I stay informed about school events and planning?
row5.description: The Event & Planning section keeps you updated on important school events, the academic calendar, holidays, and schedules for parent-teacher conferences.

row6.title: How can I view my children academic progress?
row6.description: The Academic Progress feature allows you to view your children current academic levels and overall progress, helping you support their educational journey effectively.

row7.title: How do I manage tuition payments and fees?
row7.description: Access the Fee Management section to view and manage tuition payments, school fees, and any outstanding balances for your children directly through the app.
